items.title: Vertiv Sinks 11% in a Week as Midterm Sweep Hits Data Center Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVertiv fell 11% in the past week after Democrats won Congress, reviving fears of a data center construction slowdown in Texas. The drop came less than two weeks after Vertiv beat estimates and raised its guidance.

items.title: Eaton Lost 23% in a Month. RBC Sees 58% Upside From Here
items.summary: Key TakeawaysEaton stock is down 23% in the past month. Meta Platforms’ spending plans and the Democrats’ midterm sweep hit AI power-equipment stocks across the board, Vertiv and GE Vernova included.

items.title: Seagate Soars 10% in AI Rebound as Morgan Stanley Sees “Strong Fundamentals and Weak Sentiment”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSeagate shares jumped 10% today as AI hardware stocks, including Coherent, bounced back from last week’s selloff. Morgan Stanley kept Seagate as a top pick with a $1,148 price target, citing its strong fundamentals and weak sentiment.

items.title: GE Vernova Soars 7% as Constellation Raises Guidance, Easing Data-Center Moratorium Fears
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova shares jumped 7% today, with Bloom Energy and Vertiv, after Constellation Energy beat estimates and raised its 2026 guidance. Constellation’s new deals show data-center buyers are still signing, so last week’s moratorium selloff looks overdone.

items.title: David Sacks Warns the AI Data Center Pipeline Could Dry Up. Here’s What’s at Stake
items.summary: A permitting fight could stall the buildings that every AI chip, cable, and cooling system needs. While chip stocks sank in a single month, one corner of the market barely flinched. Which suppliers are exposed, and who collects rent either way?

items.title: America’s AI Spending Boom Just Crossed a Staggering $1 Trillion Milestone
items.summary: Record shipments of AI hardware are pouring into American data centers, yet NVIDIA's stock has dropped more than 21% in a month. What does the import data reveal that the share price refuses to show, and who else profits?
